about_the_game:
"OKeverything:Evil Boy 1001 Sinful Reincarnations" - A Dark Interactive Novel
When the law fails, the gods step in.
11-year-old Wang Chengcheng escapes punishment for murder due to his age, but his death triggers a divine sentence: 1001 lifetimes as a child criminal, forced to endure the suffering of his victims while powerless to change his fate.

Game Features：
✅ Dark, immersive narrative exploring child crime, domestic abuse, and systemic corruption
✅ Multi-branching storylines with moral dilemmas that shape the protagonist's destiny
✅ Cinematic storytelling blending gritty realism with mythical elements
✅ Stunning visuals and atmospheric sound design to heighten emotional intensity

Key Storylines：

  • First Reincarnation: Liu Hanbei - A helpless teenager who was abused by his alcoholic father and bullied by school bullies for a long time;

  • A beautiful mother - She endured humiliation for his future;

  • Divine Punishment - How will he, who is gradually drowned in hatred, break out and face his own evil?

(Note: This game is the first chapter of a long novel, which ends when Liu Hanbei just transferred to an aristocratic school and began to suffer bullying.)

"Brutally honest and deeply disturbing - a masterpiece of moral ambiguity"
"The choices feel impossible, making every playthrough a soul-searching experience"

COME IN and step into the shoes of the Child of Vengeance. Will you break the cycle... or become its most fearsome agent?

content_descriptors.notes: Mature content involves: alcohol abuse, domestic violence, murder, criminal behavior, bullying，sexualacts and extreme violence.  sexual assault/non-consensual sex, or selfharm.
